verdict.rationale: MotherDuck can clearly be driven without its UI. It connects directly from the DuckDB CLI, offers official SDKs in six languages and a dbt adapter needing only a path change, supports saved credentials so sessions don't re-authenticate, and runs scheduled Python jobs through Flights. However, nothing documents CI pipelines specifically, such as non-interactive service tokens or environment-variable auth, so the CI half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation, headless service-account or token auth for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Install the DuckDB CLI and connect directly to MotherDuck
If you are using Python or CLI and don't want to authenticate every session, you can securely save your credentials locally.
DuckDB SDKs: Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java
dbt-duckdb is the adapter which allows dbt to use DuckDB and MotherDuck.
Flights handle the infrastructure: Python runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging, and versioning.
Run Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation, and operational tasks
